title: relative_time() ignores ndigits beyond 6 significant digits
property: the number printed by relative_time equals the value returned by decimal_relative_time rounded to ndigits
evidence: Docstring: ndigits is 'The number of decimal digits to round to'. decimal_relative_time returns 1.123456, but relative_time formats with f'{abs(drt):g}', which keeps only 6 significant digits, so the requested precision is silently lost.
